description: The builder on desktop (WP-36, BLD-020 to BLD-049): this computer's builder token in the key store, the updater key state and its import (the shell opens the file dialog and keeps the key; the web view never sees it), the tool check, and the fixed build steps: check out a commit, run the gates, bundle a target at a version, sign and verify the updater file, cancel. No step takes a program, a path or an argument list. Main web view only.
